audience: pharmacy staff, health software developers and analysts who work with drug names and codes in RxNorm

useCases.title: Find the standard code for a drug
useCases.text: The AI searches a drug name and returns matching RxNorm concept ids (RxCUIs) and drug products grouped by concept type. You get the right code for a name and strength.

useCases.title: Fix a misspelled drug name
useCases.text: The AI gets spelling suggestions and fuzzy matches for a term with typos or abbreviations. It then finds the intended drug.

useCases.title: Find a drug's class and the drugs in a class
useCases.text: The AI looks up the drug classes that contain a drug by name, and the drugs that belong to a class.

useCases.title: List the national drug codes of a product
useCases.text: The AI gets the NDCs linked to a drug concept, for example for one tablet or capsule strength.

useCases.title: Explore related concepts and check status and history
useCases.text: The AI gets the concepts related to a drug by term type, such as ingredient or brand name, or all related concepts. It also reads a concept's status and history.
